SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.qty * (oi.unit_price - p.cost)) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1;
